answer: Your last A1c in the records was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. That is the most recent blood sugar test on file, and there is none since. Your A1c was 7.1% in August 2025, so it has been improving since you started empagliflozin (Jardiance) in February 2025. For many people with diabetes the target is below 7%, so 6.9% is close to target. It is now more than eight months old and due for a repeat.
